'''VibroSword Seven''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of [[Syal Antilles]] during her tenure with [[VibroSword Squadron]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]. She flew an [[Eta-5 interceptor]].
